{{Current events|year=2026|month=04|day=24|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] announces that he will visit [[Pakistan]], [[Russia]], and [[Oman]] amidst a potential second round of [[ceasefire]] [[Islamabad Talks|talks]] between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/apr/24/iran-foreign-minister-to-embark-on-three-nation-tour-as-us-peace-talks-remain-stalled (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-lebanon-extend-ceasefire-trump-seeks-best-deal-with-iran-2026-04-24/ (Reuters)]
****[[White House press secretary]] [[Karoline Leavitt]] confirms that U.S. special envoys [[Steve Witkoff]] and [[Jared Kushner]] will arrive in [[Islamabad]], Pakistan, to meet with Araghchi. She also states that [[Vice President of the United States|vice president]] [[JD Vance]] will travel to Pakistan if the second round of talks are proven "successful". [https://apnews.com/article/us-iran-war-hormuz-israel-pakistan-ceasefire-april-24-2026-313e19ff213738620abe31c96eb38368 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/4/24/iran-war-live-lebanon-truce-extended-trump-says-time-not-on-tehrans-side (Al Jazeera)][https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/witkoff-kushner-headed-pakistan-iran-talks-white-house-says-2026-04-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East]]
***[[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] confirms that the {{USS|George H. W. Bush}} has arrived in the [[Middle East]]. [https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-military/2026/04/24/threes-company-trio-of-us-carriers-operating-in-middle-east-for-first-time-in-decades/ (''Navy Times'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli forces]] kill at least 12 [[Palestinians]] in attacks on the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/24/israel-kills-at-least-12-palestinians-in-gaza-amid-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**Two people are killed in a [[Unmanned Systems Forces (Russia)|Russian]] [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] on [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/russian-overnight-strikes-on-odesa-residential-buildings-kill-2-injure-14/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-odesa-kills-married-couple-officials-say-2026-04-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**The [[United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs]] reports that [[Allied Democratic Forces]] insurgents killed at least 87 civilians in separate attacks last month in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://aa.com.tr/en/africa/suspected-adf-rebels-killed-over-80-people-last-month-in-eastern-dr-congo/3917461 (AFP via AA)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]
***The [[International Energy Agency]] estimates that the damage to [[liquefied natural gas]] (LNG) [[Natural gas in Qatar|facilities]] in [[Qatar]] will strain the [[natural gas]] market for at least two years, and along with the [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|Strait of Hormuz closure]], will cause the loss of 120 billion [[Cubic metre|cubic meter]]s of LNG supply by 2030. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/iran-war-lng-supply-iea-report-gas-markets-impact/ (CBS News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 United States wildfires]]
**[[2026 Georgia wildfires]]
***[[Governor of Georgia|Georgia governor]] [[Brian Kemp]] says that two large [[wildfire|wildfires]] in southeast [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], U.S., have destroyed over 120 homes. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/24/us/georgia-wildfires-homes-destroyed.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.wsbtv.com/news/local/georgia-wildfires-gov-brian-kemp-touring-damage-south-georgia-today/T7TU74AM2VGGXIM5BD2TBEXBNM/?outputType=amp (WSB-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[Uzbekistan–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] sanctions two [[Uzbekistan]]-based [[Cotton production in Uzbekistan|cotton manufacturing plants]] for supplying raw material to the [[Arms industry of Russia|Russian defense industry]]. [https://kun.uz/en/news/2026/04/24/eu-sanctions-two-uzbek-companies-for-supplying-raw-materials-to-russian-defense-industry (Kun Uz)]
*[[International sanctions against Iran|Sanctions against Iran]]
**[[United States Secretary of the Treasury|U.S. treasury secretary]] [[Scott Bessent]] announces that the [[Office of Foreign Assets Control]] has imposed sanctions against financial networks linked to [[Iran]], including [[Digital wallet|digital asset wallets]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260424-us-treasury-announces-new-sanctions-targeting-iran-linked-cryptocurrency-networks/ (Middle East Monitor)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)]]
**[[Syria]]n authorities say that they have arrested Amjad Youssef, an intelligence officer of the [[Syrian Arab Armed Forces (Ba'athist Syria)|Syrian Arab Armed Forces]], for his role in the [[Tadamon massacre]] during the [[Syrian Civil War|civil war]]. This comes after [[Ministry of Interior (Syria)|Interior Minister]] [[Anas Khattab]] announced that he had been captured by the [[Syrian transitional government]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/amjad-youssef-key-perpetrator-tadamon-massacre-arrested-syria (Middle East Eye)]
*German biotech company [[CureVac]] sues [[Moderna]], accusing [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|their]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] Spikevax of infringing on CureVac patents. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/curevac-sues-moderna-patent-infringement-over-covid-19-vaccines-2026-04-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
* [[Peruvian political crisis (2016–present)|Peruvian political crisis]]
**[[2026 Peruvian post-electoral crisis]]
*** [[National Police of Peru|Police]] raid the home of [[Peru]]'s former chief [[Elections in Peru|electoral]] official as part of a ​new probe into alleged electoral irregularities, after he resigned this week over delays in counting ‌votes from the [[2026 Peruvian general election|recent general election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peruvian-police-raids-property-former-electoral-chief-amid-irregularities-2026-04-24/ (Reuters)]
